arguments.query: SELECT s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts, o.status FROM shipments s JOIN orders o USING(order_id) LIMIT 8
SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT count(*), count(shipped_ts), count(delivered_ts), count(distinct order_id), sum(delivered_ts<shipped_ts), min(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)), max(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)), avg(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)), sum(substr(shipped_ts,1,4)='2025'), sum(substr(delivered_ts,1,4)='2025'), sum(shipped_ts=''), sum(delivered_ts='') FROM shipments
SELECT substr(shipped_ts,1,4) y, count(*), avg(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)) FROM shipments WHERE delivered_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

SELECT 'deliv2025', count(*), avg(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)) FROM shipments WHERE substr(delivered_ts,1,4)='2025' UNION ALL SELECT 'order2025', count(*), avg(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts)) FROM shipments s JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND substr(o.order_ts,1,4)='2025'
